plugins.name: Session activity
plugins.description: Counts turns and dynamic tool calls in this app session.

tools.name: mods_session_stats
tools.description: Read turn and dynamic tool counts observed in this chat by the first-party Mods sidecar. No message contents are recorded. Use when the user asks about Mods or chat activity.

plugins.name: Turn timing
plugins.description: Measures elapsed time between turn events without reading content.

tools.name: mods_turn_timing
tools.description: Read the elapsed time of this chat's latest completed turn and current turn, as observed by the first-party Mods sidecar. Use when the user asks about Mods or turn timing.
